claims.exact_statement: For every integer k>=2 let epsilon=2^-k, E=1[v=0] on k uniform bits, and hplus=(1-E)u+E, hminus=(1-E)u-E. Supply Qb=(Pb+delta_empty)/2 and the actual conditional queried-frequency lift of their average as incoming Qh. Activate with the fixed nonlinear two-bit mask s of mean1/2 and exact flat reference Qs. Both children are nonconstant, have means +/-epsilon and identical squared spectra, and disagree with probability epsilon. The exact net reference surcharge Lambda=average Dchild-Dparent-Dcore/2 equals D_(1/4)(epsilon^2,(1+epsilon^2)/2), lies strictly between1/32 and1/8, and tends to (1/2)log2(9/8). For h0=u,h1=(1-E)u+E, disagreement epsilon/2 and one child balanced, the same prescribed reference surcharge tends to (1/2)log2(18/17)>0, with Dcore=(epsilon^2/2)log2((2+epsilon^2)/(1+epsilon^2)). Thus no finite K universally bounds Lambda by K times disagreement even with one balanced child and both children nonconstant.
hypotheses: Uniform Boolean physical cubes; entropy and KL in bits
Fixed specified incoming core conditional lift; supplied contaminated child references
Fixed exact nonlinear two-bit mask reference; no support substitution
refutes: Universal Lambda<=K*d for the specified inherited core-reference hierarchy

claims.exact_statement: For arbitrary Boolean core children with supplied finite complete references Qb satisfying Pb(empty)<=Qb(empty), the same exact nonlinear two-bit mask reference, and the prescribed incoming parent conditional lift, put A0=average Qb(empty), cb=CE(Pb,Qb), and sbar=average(K I(hb)-cb). The exact signed activation-reference surcharge obeys Lambda<=1/2 log2(1+A0/4). Given already-booked U>=0, if sbar>=2U+log2(1+A0/4), its positive part is paid from the same remaining original half-core bank sbar/2-U, retaining both complete activation child terminals and the core entropy decrement. In the explicit opposite-mean family of the preceding claim at K=4, after any old booking 0<=U<=1/8, more than1/4 remains after paying Lambda; in the one-balanced-child family more than3/4 remains for k>=2. No new core or mask reference is substituted.
hypotheses: Both supplied references normalized with finite complete cost
Empty core true mass dominated by empty supplied reference mass in each child
Qs=Ps for the nonlinear two-bit mask, so Qs(empty)=(E s)^2=1/4
Incoming parent core reference is the specified conditional lift before querying
Any existing bookings are explicitly deducted from the same original bank
